parsed.explanation: Estimate (7) is asserted with its algebra explicitly omitted, and Section 3 depends entirely on it. No other passage proves constancy while covering fixed points. A short derivation would suffice: the squared lower inequality gives b-c <= (y-t)^2/(4(t+c)) <= (y-t)^2/(4t); interchanging t and y gives c-b <= (y-t)^2/(4(y+b)) <= (y-t)^2/(4y). Combining these yields (7). As written, that derivation is absent.
